caption:
Continental Meatballs
high protein|low carb|easy recipe 

C: 11 | F: 12 | P: 35
Calories: 250 per serve 
Serves 3

Ingredients: 
450 grams chicken mince
1 tbsp garlic paste
1 grated onion
handful chopped coriander leaves / basil / parsley
45 grams cheddar cheese or whichever you prefer :) 
1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper 
1 egg
3-4 tbsp breadcrumbs / can be avoided like I did in the video but you wont be able shape them like traditional meatballs, 
1 tsp oil / not needed also if you want to cut the fat!

Method: 
combine all ingredients into a bowl 
when i made the recipe i didn’t have breadcrumbs the mix will be sticky to touch hence i use a spoon to place it on the pan. you can add as little or as much oil as you’d like to fry these
they only need a few minutes each side 

Serving Options:
a snack with some greek yogurt dip
a meal with pasta and tomato sauce
as a side dish with your regular meal - tastes great with dal chawal also
